text.p: Tropical cyclone Chantelle, with 75 mph winds, is about 265 miles east-southeast of Diego Garcia in the south India Ocean. It is expected to pass south of Diego Garcia during the next 24-36 hours. The island may see gusty winds and locally heavy rains, causing some damage. Otherwise this system is mainly a risk to shipping as winds slowly increase to about 100-105 mph during the next 48-72 hours.
Tropical depression 40w is of only a minor concern to shipping well east of the Philippines. It is already dissipating. It should be dissipated over open water in less than 24 hours.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
